startUrl.title: 🔗 immobilienscout24.de URLs (easiest way)
startUrl.description: Search on immobilienscout24.de in your browser, then paste the resulting URL(s) here — every filter you clicked (rooms, size, features, energy class, ...) is applied automatically. Works with search result pages, drawn map areas (/Suche/shape/...) and single property pages (/expose/...). Leave empty to build a search with the fields below.
startUrl.sectionCaption: Paste a URL — the fastest way to start
startUrl.sectionDescription: Anything you can filter on the website you can scrape here: copy the URL from your browser and paste it in. Fields further down are only used when no URL is given (except the limits, which always apply).

district.title: Location
district.description: City or district to search, e.g. Berlin or Munich. Ignored when a URL is provided above.
district.sectionDescription: Used only when no URL is pasted above. Either fill in a Location, or a latitude + longitude + radius for a radius search.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Scrape properties for sale or for rent

coordinates.title: Coordinates (radius search)
coordinates.description: Search around a point instead of a named place — latitude, longitude, e.g. 52.52, 13.405. Needs a radius below.

radiusKm.title: Radius
radiusKm.description: How far around the coordinates above to search

minPrice.title: Minimum price
minPrice.description: Purchase price for sale listings, base rent per month for rentals
minPrice.sectionDescription: Applied to the search built above. A pasted URL brings its own filters and overrides these.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price
maxPrice.description: Purchase price for sale listings, base rent per month for rentals

minRooms.title: Minimum rooms
minRooms.description: Fewest rooms a listing may have, e.g. 3

maxRooms.title: Maximum rooms
maxRooms.description: Most rooms a listing may have, e.g. 5

minSize.title: Minimum living space
minSize.description: Smallest living space in m², e.g. 60

maxSize.title: Maximum living space
maxSize.description: Largest living space in m², e.g. 120

equipment.title: Must have
equipment.description: Only return listings with all of the selected features

petsAllowed.title: Pets allowed
petsAllowed.description: Rentals only — only return listings that allow pets

excludeNewBuildProjects.title: Exclude new-build projects
excludeNewBuildProjects.description: Skip developer project listings, which often repeat the same building many times

sortBy.title: Sort results by
sortBy.description: "Newest first" is the one to use for monitoring the market — combine it with a small item limit to get only fresh listings.

maxItems.title: Limit the number of items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many properties. Leave empty to scrape everything the search returns.

endPage.title: Limit of scraped pages
endPage.description: Stop after this many result pages (20 properties per page)

proxy.title: Proxy configuration
proxy.description: RESIDENTIAL proxies are required — datacenter proxies are blocked by the site.

debugLog.title: Debug log
debugLog.description: Log every request the Actor makes — useful when a search returns nothing
